title: exploration: the dark half of the fleet — in-or-out verdict and primitive-parity pass for deploy, home-lab-ops, unifi, redis-channel

absorbed.basis: First-principles: the tier lever, ledger, and guard primitives defined for saga/team-execution have never been evaluated against the four dark plugins (deploy, home-lab-ops, unifi, redis-channel); the fleet's coverage story is currently an accident of which plugins ideation focused on, not a recorded decision.

executor_profile.justification: Survey-and-record exploration (grep four plugins' skills/agents dirs, cross-reference three defined primitives, write verdict table) rather than novel architectural design; second-opinion pass guards against a wrongly-recorded out verdict leaving a plugin non-compliant with this repo's own CLAUDE.md sandboxing rule.

dod_sketch: Decision/recommendation doc with per-plugin in-or-out verdicts per fleet primitive and a follow-up issue list for the ins.
ac_sketch: every dark plugin has an explicit verdict per primitive
